# rd_shadow_fine_ab, rd_shadow_fine_ab_gl
# (port/render/test/rd_shadow_fine_ab.cmake: the shadow's levels at the scene's
# scale above 1x, port/render/rd_shadowres.c, against the PS2's sizes).
# Fields: the fixture's name (port/render/test/fixtures/NAME.rdfix); the --nop
# spec of the frame's three shadow composites (list 3's SHADOW2, SHADOW1 and
# SHADOW0 sprites, as `rd_replay_tool FRAME x.png --list --no-device` prints
# them: command positions, kept by the fixture), which the test leaves out to
# find the texels the composites darken; the settings the fixture runs at,
# comma-separated (the script's header names them; the OpenGL twin runs gl1x
# and gl2x on every fixture instead).  Each frame has one shadow window with
# volumes.
#
